title: Yiwu Sourcing Agent
short: Small commodities, gifts and daily goods from the famous Yiwu wholesale market.
intro: Yiwu in Zhejiang province is known for its huge wholesale market for small commodities. Global Grabz helps you search the market, compare many suppliers in a short time, and combine small purchases into one shipment.
points: Low MOQ buying from many suppliers

faq.q: What can I buy in Yiwu?
faq.a: Yiwu is best for small commodities such as accessories, toys, stationery, gifts and household items.
Many Yiwu suppliers accept low MOQs. We combine your purchases and ship them together.

title: Shenzhen Sourcing Agent
short: Electronics, gadgets and hardware from Shenzhen, the technology hub of China.
intro: Shenzhen in Guangdong province is a centre for electronics manufacturing and product development. We connect you with factories for consumer electronics, accessories and smart devices, and manage samples and quality checks.
points: Certification document requests such as CE, FCC and RoHS
Special handling for battery and electronic cargo

faq.q: Do you handle electronics with batteries?
faq.a: Yes, but battery cargo has special shipping rules. We choose a suitable carrier and route and prepare the required documents.

faq.q: Can Shenzhen factories make custom electronics?
faq.a: Many can. We find factories with OEM and ODM experience and manage samples and approvals.

title: Guangzhou Sourcing Agent
short: Apparel, bags, shoes, beauty and furniture from the Canton Fair city.
intro: Guangzhou is a major trade city and home of the Canton Fair. It is strong in apparel, bags, shoes, cosmetics, lighting and furniture. We visit markets and factories for you and handle inspection and export.
points: Canton Fair support and supplier follow up
Export through Guangzhou and nearby ports

faq.q: Can you help me with the Canton Fair?
faq.a: Yes. We can visit the fair for you, collect catalogs and quotes, and follow up with the exhibitors you shortlist.

faq.q: Which products are strongest in Guangzhou?
faq.a: Apparel, bags, shoes, beauty products, lighting and furniture are strong categories.

title: Shanghai Sourcing Agent
short: Higher value manufacturing and one of the largest container ports in the world.
intro: Shanghai and the Yangtze River Delta have advanced factories and one of the largest container ports in the world. We source higher value products here and ship by sea and air through Shanghai.
points: Factory audits for higher value orders
Shipping through Shanghai Pudong airport and Yangshan port
FCL and LCL sea freight support

faq.a: The region has strong manufacturers, good infrastructure and direct air and sea routes to every major market.

faq.q: Do you ship through Shanghai port?
faq.a: Yes. We can ship FCL and LCL sea freight and air freight through Shanghai gateways.
